decisions.trust_scope: Restricted internal company access and company-controlled approved apps/developers; public v2.dwdcc.kr is not automatically accepted under this scope.
decisions.ui: Keep iframe-free MF/AppRoot, integrated routing, independent app builds, published SDKs and business data.
decisions.origins: Two HTTPS origins on one IP: portal for both dev/prod, console for management, CLI approval and Keycloak /identity. Domain/DNS/additional IP are not required.
decisions.authentication: Add portal/console browser purpose and fixed server ingress/route checks. Reuse current OIDC, miy-web client, realm/sub, CLI flows and token lifetimes.
decisions.cli_compatibility: Preserve relative verificationPath and existing start/exchange/poll/refresh/context/wire contracts; fixed redirect to console for both legacy/device approvals.
decisions.minimum_controls: Purpose-specific secure cookies, exact Origin/current server CSRF, management permission checks, prod explicit Use, header allowlist, API-only sandbox/nosniff, safe console strings/anti-frame, legacy/device credential revocation coverage.
decisions.tls: Certificate import, IP SAN/CA/expiry validation, endpoint trust-registration instructions and manual certificate replacement.
decisions.follow_up: Separate IdP/site/dev portal, mandatory MFA, advanced monitoring, automated CA distribution/renewal, untrusted external app isolation and mass migration tooling are not present prerequisites.
decisions.business_apps: Continue directory/current-group lookup and common ACL after minimum boundaries; PLM/PMS/PDM/MES/DAS remain independent apps. Invoke/service identities/events/large files follow feature milestones.
decisions.limitations: Same-page apps share a UI trust domain; ports do not isolate cookies; console and IdP share trust. Backend connections authenticate call chains; browser direct calls do not prove the initiating MF app or enforce its installation approval.
